packed_channels.R: shape mask as a signed distance field; 0.5 = edge; +-4 cell px -> 1.0 / 0.0
packed_channels.G: value on the ramp: ink 0.06, deep 0.29, body 0.50, light 0.70, hot 0.93; band edges [0.18, 0.4, 0.6, 0.81]
packed_channels.B: erosion order: visible while B > t (t = normalized age x erode); low = erodes first

conventions.color_space: packed atlases, trails, smears and noise are linear data (load with is_srgb = false); ramps are sRGB colour with A = HDR gain / 4
conventions.premultiplied: packed data is never premultiplied; the shader outputs premultiplied colour (AlphaMode::Premultiplied) and hot values (G > 0.80) fade to additive by G = 0.90
conventions.shader_reference: tools/vfx/vfxlib.py shade(): coverage = smoothstep(0.5-w, 0.5+w, R) with w = fwidth(R) * 0.7; coverage *= smoothstep(t-0.05, t, B); rgb, gain = ramp(G); ink band alpha x 0.90; out = (rgb*gain*a, a*(1-add))
conventions.uv: atlas cells: u right, v down (image rows); frame i of a sequence is cell (col0 + i, row)
conventions.pivot: per sequence: the effect origin in cell-relative uv (0..1)
conventions.flipbook_timing: fps is the playback rate; frame_times_60 (when present) lists the 60 fps frame each flipbook frame was painted at, so a front-loaded burst plays fast-in, slow-out at a constant fps
conventions.strips: trails and smears: u = 0 at the tail (oldest end), 1 at the head (newest end); v = 0 inner / left edge, 1 outer / right edge; tileable_u rows repeat seamlessly along u
conventions.meshes: glTF 2.0 binary, +Y up, forward = -Z (Transform::looking_to), metres; COLOR_0 carries the same packing (R = 1 mask, G = value band, B = erosion order); UV0 as documented per mesh
conventions.sizes: radius_in_cell: the gameplay radius R as a fraction of the half cell; quad side = 2R / radius_in_cell
